meta.description: The ORVIBO Smart Pan-Tilt Camera turns 355° horizontally and 75° vertically and films in 1080P Full HD, with infrared night vision, motion alerts, two-way talk and recording to a microSD card or the cloud.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO Smart Pan-Tilt Camera (SC32PT) specifications: 2 MP, 1920 × 1080, 355° horizontal and 75° vertical rotation, infrared up to 10 m, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, microSD card up to 128 GB.
w.title: Smart Pan-Tilt Camera
w.subtitle: 1080P Full HD and 355° patrol: see more, more clearly
w.content:
1080P Full HD wide angle | Dual-axis pan-tilt | Powerful infrared night vision
Motion detection alerts | Two-way voice talk
title.title: 1080P HD: a full upgrade in picture quality
content.content:
1080P HD, 2 megapixels and 4× digital zoom that keeps details sharp and undistorted.
The professional Hi3518Ev200 image processor gives rich, full colors, every detail as fine and true as seeing it yourself.
compare.photo: A gray cat on a sofa, filmed in 720P on the left and in 1080P on the right
w.desc: The dual-axis pan-tilt head turns 355° horizontally and 75° vertically; with its 125° wide angle, it watches from every angle, side to side and top to bottom.
w.title3: Upgraded infrared night vision: see clearly in the dark
w.desc2: Stronger infrared processing gives clearer night vision: in dim or almost no light, you see every detail you want to see.
alt.night: The same room at night, filmed by the smart pan-tilt camera (left, clear) and by an ordinary pan-tilt camera (right, darker).
w.title4: Sensitive motion detection: nothing at home gets past it
w.desc3:
It spots unusual movement at home right away, films it automatically and uploads the recording to the cloud in real time.
At the same time, an alert reaches the ORVIBO Home app, so you know right away what's happening at home and can watch it live.
title.title2: Watch live from anywhere, with home in the palm of your hand
w.title5: Look in on grandparents and kids anytime
w.desc4: When grandparents or kids are home alone, check on them from your phone wherever you are and always know how things are at home.
w.title6: Look after your pets from afar
w.desc5: Pets roam the whole house and love hiding in corners. The camera's extra-wide angle finds them quickly, even tucked away in a corner.
w.title7: Real-time two-way talk, as smooth as a phone call
w.desc6: A professionally tuned built-in microphone and speaker keep voices clear. Just hold the Talk button to chat with your family “face to face” and never miss an important moment.
w.title8: Nonstop 24/7 recording keeps life's warm moments
w.desc7:
The camera records locally too: insert a microSD card and it saves what it films to the card.
It also offers secure cloud storage with real-time upload, so space is never a worry: it records nonstop in a loop, and you can play back the saved videos remotely.
w.title9: Smart security that works together, protecting every room 24/7
w.desc8: Together with the security devices you already have in ORVIBO Home, it guards your whole home around the clock, so you can care for your family even better.
